listing.name: Girls Frontline Portraits Megapack
listing.summary: Adds over 1400 portraits from Girls' Frontline characters to player and vanilla factions, along with 10 faction flags.
listing.aiSummary: Adds over 1400 portraits from Girls' Frontline characters to player and vanilla factions, along with 10 faction flags.

description:
Girls' Frontline Portraits Megapack

DOWNLOAD LINK [v1.1.2]

Contains over 1400 portraits from characters of Girls' Frontline, added to your player faction and other vanilla factions (with certain portrait groups being exempt).

Also includes 10 flags from major and minor factions you encounter throughout the story.

Should be safe to download and drop right into your modpack.

May induce lag should the entire pack be included.

Portraits Preview

"Wait, there are dudes here as well?"

[close]

Flags Preview

[close]

Included Contents

Base Pack & FlagsNeural Upgrades PackCostume Party - Skins PackRingleaders & Notable Characters PackIron Blood - Mob Enemies Pack

Does not contain content from collaborations between Girls Frontline and other IPs (with certain exceptions)

Certain elements were excluded from the pack as they would not be SFW, potentially disturbing, or are just orphans who would be committing saturation bombardments under your command.

All portraits were sourced from Girls' Frontline official artworks, and belongs to Sunborn / MICA Team.

[close]

Changelogs(MM/DD/YY Format)

1.1.2 - 03/10/26 - Added version checking support.

1.1.1 - 02/21/26

Added 3 flags for the following factions: IOP, 16Lab, OGAS
Added 5 portraits to the Base pack.
Added 4 portraits to the Iron Blood pack.
Added 2 portraits to the Ringleaders pack.

1.1.0 - 01/31/26

Marked the mods' name with numbers for mod list display priority.
Changed internal directory for player faction flags - may cause issues if you updating from an older version WHILE using any of the flags from this pack.
Added 1 portrait to the Skins pack.
Added 3 portraits to the Ringleaders pack.

1.0.0 - 12/29/25

Added 34 portraits for HOC girls. Show them some love would ya?
Added 7 flags for the following factions: Griffin, Sangvis Ferri, KCCO, Paradeus, Statesec, NVA, Daybreak Squad.

0.9.0 - 12/26/25 - Initial Forums Release

[close]

It's been a journey, Commanders.

It truly was a Girls' Frontline

.

DISCLAIMERS

: I am not affiliated with Haze or any of the people behind the original Girls' Frontline portrait pack. This work is completely separate from theirs, and does not use nor derive from any of its content.
